issues.current_text: Samsung está aproveitando a brecha: elevou yields para ~60% no 2nm, fechou contratos com Tesla e Apple

issues.suggestion: Exact same data point (60% yields, Tesla+Apple contracts) repeated 2 days later. Either cut Samsung 2nm entirely or mention only the new Jensen Huang/Grok 3 detail.

issues.previous_text: A Fab 4 da TSMC no Arizona, prevista para 2030, já está totalmente reservada sem que uma pá tenha virado o solo
issues.suggestion: TSMC Arizona fab fully booked was covered on 03-29. The 2nm sold-out-until-2028 angle is new — keep that, drop the Arizona mention or acknowledge it was already reported.

issues.current_text: a empresa já está em $19bi de ARR, à frente das projeções de janeiro

issues.suggestion: The $19bi ARR figure was the lead story 2 days ago. The Coatue valuation projection is new — reframe around that and drop or condense the ARR mention to 'a empresa, cujo ARR já superou as projeções'.

issues.suggestion: Micron crash was part of the 03-28 memory selloff story. The post-earnings drop is a continuation — frame it as such ('Micron estendeu as perdas iniciadas pelo TurboQuant') instead of presenting as a fresh event.

issues.current_text: negociações de paz empacam: os EUA exigem que o Irã entregue 10 mil kg de material físsil... Teerã responde com contra-demandas

issues.suggestion: Three consecutive editions frame Iran talks as 'demands and counter-demands stalling negotiations'. The specific demands are new, but the 'talks going nowhere' angle is stale. Lead with what actually changed (new US conditions) rather than re-establishing the stalemate framing.

issues.current_text: petróleo Brent fechou março com alta de 56% ... WTI superou $100 pela primeira vez desde 2022
issues.previous_text: Brent se mantendo acima de $100 após alta de 5% na sexta
issues.suggestion: Oil above $100 has been mentioned in every edition this week. The 56% monthly high and WTI crossing $100 are genuinely new milestones — lead with those and skip re-establishing that Brent is above $100.

summary: High repetition: Samsung 2nm yields (identical data), TSMC capacity (3 editions running), Anthropic $19bi ARR (2 days ago), and Optimus Gen 3 (2 days ago) are the worst offenders. Iran/oil framing is stale but has new data points.
